member.name: T:BepuPhysics.BodyInertias
member.summary: 存储物体的局部和世界视角的惯性，打包在一起以便高效访问。(Stores the local and world views of a body's inertia, packed together for efficient access.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.BodyInertias.Local
member.summary: 物体的局部惯性。(Local inertia of the body.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.BodyInertias.World
member.summary: 物体的变换后世界惯性。注意，这仅在更新它的速度积分和随后的位置积分之间有效。在此执行窗口之外，应将其视为未定义。(Transformed world inertia of the body. Note that this is only valid between the velocity integration that updates it and the pose integration that follows. Outside of that execution window, this should be considered undefined.)
member.remarks: 我们在这里缓存它，因为速度积分需要局部和世界惯性，并且求解器中发生的任何积分都将在没有顺序加载的情况下进行。在这种情况下，能够加载单个缓存行来获取局部和世界惯性非常有帮助。(We cache this here because velocity integration wants both the local and world inertias, and any integration happening within the solver will do so without the benefit of sequential loads. In that context, being able to load a single cache line to grab both local and world inertia helps quite a lot.)

member.name: M:BepuPhysics.BodyInertias.ToString
member.summary: 返回表示 BodyInertias 的字符串。(Returns a string representing the BodyInertias.)
member.returns: 表示 BodyInertias 的字符串。(String representing the BodyInertias.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.BodyDynamics
member.summary: 将所有求解器所需的物体信息存储在一起。(Stores all body information needed by the solver together.)
member.remarks: 在2.4版本对求解器的重构中，每个求解阶段都会为约束中的每个物体加载位置、速度、和惯性。 L2预取器通常以成对的缓存行获取内存（参见 https://www.intel.com/content/dam/www/public/us/en/documents/manuals/64-ia-32-architectures-optimization-manual.pdf#page=162）。 由于 L2 在加载运动状态或惯性时可能会拉取相邻的缓存行，它们最好一起存放在一个块中。 注意，这伴随着对缓冲区池默认对齐方式更改为128字节的改变。(With 2.4's revamp of the solver, every solving stage loads pose, velocity, and inertia for every body in each constraint. L2 prefetchers often fetch memory in even-odd pairs of cache lines. Since L2 is likely pulling in adjacent cache lines when loading either motion state or inertias, they might as well live together in one block. Note that this goes along with a change to the buffer pool's default alignment to 128 bytes.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.BodyActivity
member.summary: 描述物体如何休眠及其当前休眠状态。(Describes how a body sleeps, and its current state with respect to sleeping.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.BodyActivity.SleepThreshold
member.summary: 允许物体休眠的速度平方阈值。将其与 dot(linearVelocity, linearVelocity) + dot(angularVelocity, angularVelocity) 进行比较。将此值设置为负数可确保物体在没有用户操作的情况下无法休眠。(Threshold of squared velocity under which the body is allowed to go to sleep. This is compared against dot(linearVelocity, linearVelocity) + dot(angularVelocity, angularVelocity). Setting this to a negative value guarantees the body cannot go to sleep without user action.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.BodyActivity.MinimumTimestepsUnderThreshold
member.summary: 物体在低于休眠阈值后必须保持的时间步数，之后才成为休眠候选。注意，物体在满足此最小值后不保证立即休眠。(The number of time steps that the body must be under the sleep threshold before the body becomes a sleeping candidate. Note that the body is not guaranteed to go to sleep immediately after meeting this minimum.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.BodyActivity.TimestepsUnderThresholdCount
member.summary: 如果物体处于唤醒状态，这是物体速度低于休眠阈值的时间步数。(If the body is awake, this is the number of time steps that the body has had a velocity below the sleep threshold.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.BodyActivity.SleepCandidate
member.summary: 如果此物体是休眠候选，则为 true。如果通过约束与之连接的所有物体也都是候选，则此物体可能会进入休眠。(True if this body is a candidate for being slept. If all the bodies that it is connected to by constraints are also candidates, this body may go to sleep.)

member.name: P:BepuPhysics.BodyReference.CollidableReference
member.summary:
获取此物体的 CollidableReference。CollidableReference 通过包含物体的动态/运动学/静态状态及其句柄来唯一标识模拟中的碰撞体对象。
尽管命名不幸冲突，CollidableReference 与直接引用物体的碰撞体数据（可通过 Collidable 属性获取）是不同的。 (
Gets a CollidableReference for this body. CollidableReferences uniquely identify a collidable object in a simulation by including both the dynamic/kinematic/static state of the object and its handle.
Despite an unfortunate naming collision, CollidableReferences are distinct from a direct reference to a body's collidable data, which you can get from the Collidable property.)

member.name: P:BepuPhysics.BodyReference.HasLockedInertia
member.summary: 获取物体是否具有锁定惯性（即其逆惯性张量为零）。(Gets whether the body has locked inertia, meaning its inverse inertia tensor is zero.)

member.name: M:BepuPhysics.BodyReference.BecomeKinematic
member.summary: 如果物体是动态的，则通过将所有逆惯性和质量值设置为零并激活它，将物体变为运动学。任何连接到该物体且现在仅包含运动学引用的约束将被移除。如果物体已经是运动学，则不执行任何操作。(If the body is dynamic, turns the body kinematic by setting all inverse inertia and mass values to zero and activates it. Any constraints connected to the body that now only contain kinematic references are removed. If the body is kinematic, does nothing.)

member.name: M:BepuPhysics.BodyReference.SetLocalInertia(BepuPhysics.BodyInertia@)
member.summary: 将物体的局部惯性设置为给定的惯性。唤醒物体并正确处理动态和运动学状态之间的任何转换。如果物体从动态变为运动学，任何连接到该物体且现在仅包含运动学引用的约束将被移除。(Sets the body's local inertia to the provided inertia. Wakes up the body and correctly handles any transition between dynamic and kinematic states. If the body moves from dynamic to kinematic, any constraints connected to the body that now only contain kinematic references are removed.)

member.summary: 基于 LocalInertia 和 Pose 计算物体的世界空间逆惯性张量。(Computes the world space inverse inertia tensor for the body based on the LocalInertia and Pose.)

member.name: M:BepuPhysics.BodyReference.ApplyDescription(BepuPhysics.BodyDescription@)
member.summary: 根据描述设置物体的属性。正确处理动态和运动学之间以及无形状和有形状之间的任何转换。如果物体变为运动学，任何仅包含运动学物体的约束将被移除。唤醒物体并更新其在 broad phase 中的边界。(Sets a body's properties according to a description. Properly handles any transitions between dynamic and kinematic and between shapeless and shapeful. If the body is becoming kinematic, any constraints which only contain kinematic bodies will be removed. Wakes up the body and updates its bounds in the broad phase.)
member.param: 物体的描述。(Description of the body.)

member.param: 要用于物体的新形状的索引。(Index of the new shape to use for the body.)

member.name: P:BepuPhysics.BodyReference.BoundingBox
member.summary: 获取物体边界框的副本。如果物体没有形状，则边界框的最小值为 float.MaxValue，最大值为 float.MinValue。(Gets a copy of the body's bounding box. If the body has no shape, the bounding box has a min at float.MaxValue and a max at float.MinValue.)

member.name: M:BepuPhysics.BodyReference.GetBoundsReferencesFromBroadPhase(System.Numerics.Vector3*@,System.Numerics.Vector3*@)
member.summary: 获取指向 broad phase 中物体边界框最小值和最大值的直接指针。如果物体没有形状，则输出 null。(Gets direct pointers to the body's bounding box minimum and maximum in the broad phase. Outputs null if the body has no shape.)
member.param: 指向 broad phase 中边界框最小值的指针。如果物体没有形状，则为 null。(Pointer to the bounding box minimum in the broad phase. Null if the body has no shape.)
指向 broad phase 中边界框最大值的指针。如果物体没有形状，则为 null。(Pointer to the bounding box maximum in the broad phase. Null if the body has no shape.)
member.returns: 如果物体有形状和边界，则返回 true；否则返回 false。(True if the body has a shape and bounds, false otherwise.)

member.name: M:BepuPhysics.BodyReference.UpdateBounds
member.summary: 根据物体当前状态更新 broad phase 中的物体边界。不包括速度扩展。如果物体没有形状，则不执行任何操作。(Updates the body's bounds in the broad phase for its current state. Does not include velocity expansion. Does nothing if the body has no shape.)
member.remarks: 如果在下一个时间步之前希望将修改的物体状态反映在 broad phase 中，此方法会很有用。例如，如果直接移动物体后要对其执行射线投射，则必须更新其边界，否则 broad phase 边界将过时，射线很可能会错过。(Can be useful if you made modifications to the body's state that you want reflected in the broad phase before the next timestep. For example, if you want to perform ray casts against the broad phase after moving objects around directly, their bounds must be updated or else the broad phase bounds will be out of date and the ray will likely miss.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.Collidables.ContinuousDetectionMode
member.summary: 定义碰撞体在有速度的情况下如何处理碰撞检测。(Defines how a collidable will handle collision detection in the presence of velocity.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.Collidables.ContinuousDetectionMode.Discrete
member.summary:
不执行扫描测试。默认的推测性接触生成将在推测边距内发生。
碰撞体的边界框不会通过速度扩展到推测边距之外。
这是最便宜的模式。如果离散模式碰撞体快速移动并且最大推测边距受限，其边界框未扩展的事实可能导致其即使与非离散碰撞体也错过碰撞。 (
No sweep tests are performed. Default speculative contact generation will occur within the speculative margin.
The collidable's bounding box will not be expanded by velocity beyond the speculative margin.
This is the cheapest mode. If a Discrete mode collidable is moving quickly and the maximum speculative margin is limited, the fact that its bounding box is not expanded may cause it to miss a collision even with a non-Discrete collidable.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.Collidables.ContinuousDetectionMode.Passive
member.summary:
不执行扫描测试。默认的推测性接触生成将在推测边距内发生。
碰撞体的边界框将通过速度扩展，而不受推测边距的限制。
当碰撞体可能快速移动且本身不需要连续检测，但存在其他具有连续模式的碰撞体应避免错过碰撞时，这很有用。 (
No sweep tests are performed. Default speculative contact generation will occur within the speculative margin.
The collidable's bounding box will be expanded by velocity without being limited by the speculative margin.
This is useful when a collidable may move quickly and does not itself require continuous detection, but there exist other collidables with continuous modes that should avoid missing collisions.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.Collidables.ContinuousDetectionMode.Continuous
member.summary:
碰撞检测将从扫描测试开始，以识别可能的时间点。将为预测的碰撞生成推测性接触。
此模式可以用非常少的幽灵碰撞捕获角运动。然而，它可能会错过由于主要冲击速度变化而发生的二次碰撞。 (
Collision detection will start with a sweep test to identify a likely time of impact. Speculative contacts will be generated for the predicted collision.
This mode can capture angular motion with very few ghost collisions. It can, however, miss secondary collisions that would have occurred due to the primary impact's velocity change.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.Collidables.ContinuousDetection
member.summary: 定义碰撞体如何处理具有显著速度的碰撞。(Defines how a collidable handles collisions with significant velocity.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.Collidables.ContinuousDetection.Mode
member.summary: 连续碰撞检测模式。(The continuous collision detection mode.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.Collidables.ContinuousDetection.MinimumSweepTimestep
member.summary: 如果使用 ，这定义了扫描测试在搜索首次碰撞时间时将取得的最小进展。持续时间小于 的碰撞可能会被扫描测试错过。使用较大的值可以显著提高扫描测试的性能。(If using , this defines the minimum progress that the sweep test will make when searching for the first time of impact. Collisions lasting less than may be missed by the sweep test. Using larger values can significantly increase the performance of sweep tests.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.Collidables.ContinuousDetection.SweepConvergenceThreshold
member.summary: 如果使用 ，如果碰撞时间区域已被细化到小于 ，扫描测试将终止。值越接近零，将越接近真实的碰撞时间，但对于推测性接触生成，较大的值通常效果很好。较大的值允许扫描更早终止，并可以显著提高扫描性能。(If using , sweep tests will terminate if the time of impact region has been refined to be smaller than . Values closer to zero will converge more closely to the true time of impact, but for speculative contact generation larger values usually work fine. Larger values allow the sweep to terminate much earlier and can significantly improve sweep performance.)

member.name: P:BepuPhysics.Collidables.ContinuousDetection.AllowExpansionBeyondSpeculativeMargin
member.summary: 获取连续碰撞检测配置是否允许边界框扩展到计算的推测边距之外。(Gets whether the continuous collision detection configuration will permit bounding box expansion beyond the calculated speculative margin.)

member.name: P:BepuPhysics.Collidables.ContinuousDetection.Discrete
member.summary:
不执行扫描测试。默认的推测性接触生成将在推测边距内发生。
碰撞体的边界框不会通过速度扩展到推测边距之外。
如果使用有限的最大推测边距，这可能比被动模式略微便宜。如果离散模式碰撞体快速移动并且最大推测边距受限，其边界框未扩展的事实可能导致其即使与非离散碰撞体也错过碰撞。
注意，离散和被动仅在最大推测边距受限时有所不同。 (
No sweep tests are performed. Default speculative contact generation will occur within the speculative margin.
The collidable's bounding box will not be expanded by velocity beyond the speculative margin.
This can be marginally cheaper than Passive modes if using a limited maximum speculative margin. If a Discrete mode collidable is moving quickly and the maximum speculative margin is limited, the fact that its bounding box is not expanded may cause it to miss a collision even with a non-Discrete collidable.
Note that Discrete and Passive only differ if maximum speculative margin is restricted.)
member.returns: 给定离散配置的检测设置。(Detection settings for the given discrete configuration.)

The collidable's bounding box and speculative margin will be expanded by velocity.
This is useful when a collidable may move quickly and does not itself require continuous detection, but there exist other collidables with continuous modes that should avoid missing collisions.)

与扫描终止的碰撞时间区域进行比较的阈值。如果区域已被细化到小于 SweepConvergenceThreshold，扫描将终止。值越接近零，将越接近真实的碰撞时间，但对于推测性接触生成，较大的值通常效果很好。较大的值允许扫描更早终止，并可以显著提高扫描性能。(Threshold against which the time of impact region is compared for sweep termination. member.name: F:BepuPhysics.Collidables.Collidable.MinimumSpeculativeMargin
member.summary: 碰撞体使用的推测边距值的下界。(Lower bound on the value of the speculative margin used by the collidable.)
member.remarks: 0 通常是一个不错的默认值。如果速度大小是推测边距的不良代理，可以选择更高的值，但这种情况很少见。在这种情况下，请尝试使用满足要求的最小值，以避免创建不必要的接触约束。(0 tends to be a good default value. Higher values can be chosen if velocity magnitude is a poor proxy for speculative margins, but these cases are rare. In those cases, try to use the smallest value that still satisfies requirements to avoid creating unnecessary contact constraints.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.Collidables.Collidable.MaximumSpeculativeMargin
member.summary: 碰撞体使用的推测边距值的上界。(Upper bound on the value of the speculative margin used by the collidable.)
member.remarks: 通常是离散或被动模式碰撞体的不错默认值。推测边距将随速度大小成比例增加，因此如果物体移动速度不快，拥有无限最大值不会增加额外成本。较小的值有助于在混乱情况下提高性能，其中错过碰撞是可以接受的。当使用 时，大于速度大小的推测边距将导致跳过扫描测试，因此降低最大边距有助于避免幽灵碰撞。( tends to be a good default value for discrete or passive mode collidables. The speculative margin will increase in size proportional to velocity magnitude, so having an unlimited maximum won't cost extra if the body isn't moving fast. Smaller values can be useful for improving performance in chaotic situations where missing a collision is acceptable. When using , a speculative margin larger than the velocity magnitude will result in the sweep test being skipped, so lowering the maximum margin can help avoid ghost collisions.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.Collidables.Collidable.SpeculativeMargin
member.summary:
自动计算的形状表面周围可以生成接触的边距大小。这些接触将具有负深度，并且仅当帧的速度将推动一对形状重叠时才会贡献。
此值由每帧的边界框预测自动设置，并受碰撞体的 和 值约束。碰撞对的最终推测边距也可以在 回调中修改。
此值应为正以避免抖动。
它也可以用作一种连续碰撞检测形式，但过高的值结合快速运动可能导致可见的“幽灵碰撞”伪影。为了减少幽灵碰撞的机会，请使用 。
如果使用 ，请考虑将 设置为较小的值，以帮助过滤幽灵碰撞。
有关更多信息，请参阅 ContinuousCollisionDetection.md 文档。 (Automatically computed size of the margin around the surface of the shape in which contacts can be generated. These contacts will have negative depth and only contribute if the frame's velocities would push the shapes of a pair into overlap.
This is automatically set by bounding box prediction each frame, and is bound by the collidable's and values. The effective speculative margin for a collision pair can also be modified from callbacks.
This should be positive to avoid jittering.
It can also be used as a form of continuous collision detection, but excessively high values combined with fast motion may result in visible 'ghost collision' artifacts. For continuous collision detection with less chance of ghost collisions, use .
If using , consider setting to a smaller value to help filter ghost collisions.
For more information, see the ContinuousCollisionDetection.md documentation.)

member.summary: 碰撞体使用的推测边距值的下界。(Lower bound on the value of the speculative margin used by the collidable.)
member.remarks: 0 通常是一个不错的默认值。如果速度大小是推测边距的不良代理，可以选择更高的值，但这种情况很少见。在这种情况下，请尝试使用满足要求的最小值，以避免创建不必要的接触约束。(0 tends to be a good default value. In those cases, try to use the smallest value that still satisfies requirements to avoid creating unnecessary contact constraints.)

member.summary: 计算关于角速度应如何扩展边界框的信息。(Computes information about how the bounding box should be expanded in response to angular velocity.)
member.remarks: 这通常在引擎中用于在帧开始时预测边界框。速度用于扩展边界框，以便检测可能的未来碰撞。线速度以直接简单的方式扩展边界框，但角扩展需要更多关于形状的信息。想象一下长而细的胶囊与球体：高角速度可能需要胶囊的显著扩展，但球体是旋转不变的。(This is typically used in the engine for predicting bounding boxes at the beginning of the frame. Velocities are used to expand the bounding box so that likely future collisions will be detected. Linear velocity expands the bounding box in a direct and simple way, but angular expansion requires more information about the shape. Imagine a long and thin capsule versus a sphere: high angular velocity may require significant expansion on the capsule, but spheres are rotationally invariant.)

member.name: M:BepuPhysics.Collidables.Mesh.CreateWithoutTreeBuild(BepuUtilities.Memory.Buffer{BepuPhysics.Collidables.Triangle},System.Numerics.Vector3,BepuUtilities.Memory.BufferPool)
member.summary: 创建一个网格形状实例，但将 Tree 留在未构建状态。必须构建树后才能使用网格。(Creates a mesh shape instance, but leaves the Tree in an unbuilt state. The tree must be built before the mesh can be used.)
member.param: 要在网格中使用的三角形。(Triangles to use in the mesh.)

要在运行时应用于所有顶点的缩放。注意，缩放比例不会烘焙到三角形或加速结构中；同一组三角形和加速结构可以用于具有不同缩放比例的不同网格实例。(Scale to apply to all vertices at runtime. Note that the scale is not baked into the triangles or acceleration structure; the same set of triangles and acceleration structure can be used across multiple Mesh instances with different scales.)
用于分配加速结构的池。(Pool used to allocate acceleration structures.)
member.returns: 创建的网格形状。(Created mesh shape.)
member.remarks: 在某些情况下，默认的分箱构建可能不是理想的构建器。此函数执行设置树所需的所有操作，而无需花费计算加速结构细节的开销。然后用户可以运行任何适当的构建/细化过程。(In some cases, the default binned build may not be the ideal builder. This function does everything needed to set up a tree without the expense of figuring out the details of the acceleration structure. The user can then run whatever build/refinement process is appropriate.)

member.name: M:BepuPhysics.Collidables.Mesh.CreateWithSweepBuild(BepuUtilities.Memory.Buffer{BepuPhysics.Collidables.Triangle},System.Numerics.Vector3,BepuUtilities.Memory.BufferPool)
member.summary: 创建一个网格形状实例，并使用扫描构建器构建加速结构。(Creates a mesh shape instance and builds an acceleration structure using a sweep builder.)
member.param: 要在网格中使用的三角形。(Triangles to use in the mesh.)

要在运行时应用于所有顶点的缩放。注意，缩放比例不会烘焙到三角形或加速结构中；同一组三角形和加速结构可以用于具有不同缩放比例的不同网格实例。(Scale to apply to all vertices at runtime. Note that the scale is not baked into the triangles or acceleration structure; the same set of triangles and acceleration structure can be used across multiple Mesh instances with different scales.)
用于分配加速结构的池。(Pool used to allocate acceleration structures.)
member.returns: 创建的网格形状。(Created mesh shape.)
member.remarks: 扫描构建器比分箱构建器慢得多，但有时可以创建更高质量的树。注意，分箱构建器可以调整以创建更高质量的树。这通常比尝试使用扫描构建器更好；此处主要是出于遗留原因。(The sweep builder is significantly slower than the binned builder, but can sometimes create higher quality trees. Note that the binned builder can be tuned to create higher quality trees. That is usually a better choice than trying to use the sweep builder; this is here primarily for legacy reasons.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.BoundingBoxBatcher.CollidablesPerFlush
member.summary: 在执行 AABB 更新之前，每类型累积的物体数量。每批的物体越多，虚拟开销和执行发散就越少。然而，这应该保持足够低，使得边界框更新必须收集的数据通常仍在 L1 中。(The number of bodies to accumulate per type before executing an AABB update. The more bodies per batch, the less virtual overhead and execution divergence. However, this should be kept low enough such that the data that has to be gathered by the bounding box update is still usually in L1.)

member.summary: 计算关于应如何根据角速度扩展边界框的信息。(Computes information about how the bounding box should be expanded in response to angular velocity.)
member.remarks: 这通常在引擎中用于在帧开始时预测边界框。速度用于扩展边界框，以便检测到可能的未来碰撞。线速度以直接简单的方式扩展边界框，但角扩展需要更多关于形状的信息。想象一下细长的胶囊体与球体：高角速度可能需要在胶囊体上进行显著扩展，但球体是旋转不变的。(This is typically used in the engine for predicting bounding boxes at the beginning of the frame. Velocities are used to expand the bounding box so that likely future collisions will be detected. Linear velocity expands the bounding box in a direct and simple way, but angular expansion requires more information about the shape. Imagine a long and thin capsule versus a sphere: high angular velocity may require significant expansion on the capsule, but spheres are rotationally invariant.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.BoundingBoxBatcher.CollidablesPerFlush
member.summary: 在执行 AABB 更新之前，每种类型要累积的物体数量。每批的物体越多，虚拟开销和执行发散就越少。然而，这应该保持足够低，以便边界框更新必须收集的数据仍然通常在 L1 中。(The number of bodies to accumulate per type before executing an AABB update. The more bodies per batch, the less virtual overhead and execution divergence. However, this should be kept low enough such that the data that has to be gathered by the bounding box update is still usually in L1.)

If neither collidable in a pair is compound, this will not be called. For compound-including pairs, if the earlier call to AllowContactGeneration returns false for owning pair, this will not be called. Note that it is possible for this function to be called twice for the same subpair if the pair has continuous collision detection enabled; the CCD sweep test that runs before the contact generation test also asks before performing child pair tests.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.CollisionDetection.PreflushJobType.DeterministicConstraintAdd
member.summary: 按先前排序确定的顺序，并在推测计算的批次目标的帮助下，将约束添加到求解器和约束图中。局部顺序执行。在创建或调整类型批次时访问主线程缓冲区池。(Adds constraints to the solver and constraint graph in an order determined by the previous sorts and with the help of the speculatively computed batch targets. Locally sequential. Accesses main thread buffer pool when type batches are created or resized.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.CollisionDetection.PreflushJobType.NondeterministicConstraintAdd
member.summary: 按碰撞检测阶段确定的顺序将约束添加到求解器和约束图中。如果由于线程问题碰撞检测阶段不确定，则这将导致对求解器的不确定添加。(Adds constraints to the solver and constraint graph in an order determined by the collision detection phase. member.name: F:BepuPhysics.CollisionDetection.PairCache.PairFreshness
member.summary: 每对“新鲜度”标志，由窄阶段执行在添加或更新对时设置。仅在窄阶段执行期间初始化。(Per-pair 'freshness' flags set when a pair is added or updated by the narrow phase execution. Only initialized for the duration of the narrowphase's execution.)
member.remarks: 这每个对存储一个字节。虽然它可以压缩到1位，但这需要手动确保线程安全。通过使用字节，我们依赖于对不大于本机指针大小的数据类型的原子设置行为。此外，较小的尺寸实际上在增加错误共享方面代价更高。数据类型的选择是后分析的内存带宽和错误共享频率之间的平衡。(This stores one byte per pair. While it could be compressed to 1 bit, that requires manually ensuring thread safety. By using bytes, we rely on the atomic setting behavior for data types no larger than the native pointer size. Further, smaller sizes actually pay a higher price in terms of increased false sharing. Choice of data type is a balancing act between the memory bandwidth of the post analysis and the frequency of false sharing.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.Constraints.TypeBatch
member.summary: 存储与类型批次中约束关联的原始 AOSOA 格式数据。(Stores the raw AOSOA formatted data associated with constraints in a type batch.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.Constraints.TypeProcessor
member.summary: 约束类型批次处理器的超类。负责解释原始类型批次以进行簿记和求解。(Superclass of constraint type batch processors. Responsible for interpreting raw type batches for the purposes of bookkeeping and solving.)
member.remarks:
此类本身不持有任何状态。求解器为每个注册的约束类型创建一个唯一的类型处理器，并且所有实例都保存在无类型内存中。将功能与数据分离允许更少的 GC 跟踪实例，并允许更容易地共享原始数据布局。
例如，休眠模拟岛屿存储类型批次，但它们的创建和使用方式不同——为了方便，它们以每个岛屿为基础存储。使用相同的系统但使用引用类型 TypeBatches，数万个非活动岛屿将意味着数万个 GC 跟踪的对象。 这是不可接受的，所以我们在这里。
从概念上讲，你可以将求解器的 TypeProcessors 数组视为类似 C 的函数指针。(This class holds no actual state of its own. A solver creates a unique type processor for each registered constraint type, and all instances are held in untyped memory. Splitting the functionality from the data allows for far fewer GC-tracked instances and allows the raw data layout to be shared more easily. For example, sleeping simulation islands store type batches, but they are created and used differently- and for convenience, they are stored on a per-island basis. Using the same system but with reference type TypeBatches, tens of thousands of inactive islands would imply tens of thousands of GC-tracked objects. That's not acceptable, so here we are. Conceptually, you can think of the solver's array of TypeProcessors like C function pointers.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.LocalSpinWait
member.summary: 行为类似于框架 SpinWait，但从不自愿将时间片让给非核心线程。(Behaves like a framework SpinWait, but never voluntarily relinquishes the timeslice to off-core threads.)
member.remarks:
使用此替代常规框架 SpinWait 有两个主要原因：
1) 框架的 spinwait 在诉诸任何形式的让步之前会旋转相当长的时间。根据经验，这对于求解器来说并不理想——如果同步条件在几纳秒内未满足，通常会延迟几微秒。此 spinwait 在让步方面更激进。
2) 经过一定次数的让步后，框架 SpinWait 将调用 Sleep。这扩大了可调度线程的潜在集合，包括那些不本地于当前核心的线程。如果允许此转换，很可能驱逐缓存的求解器数据。（对于非常大的模拟，使用 Sleep(0) 并不是那么令人担忧——每次迭代都可能大到足以驱逐所有缓存——但使用让步仍然没有太多好处。）
SpinWait 默认也会回退到 Sleep(1)，这会严重破坏性能，但可以通过配置禁用该行为。
注意，这并不表示框架 SpinWait 应该更改，而是说明求解器的要求非常具体，与通用解决方案不太匹配。 (
There are two big reasons for using this over the regular framework SpinWait:
1) The framework spinwait relies on spins for quite a while before resorting to any form of timeslice surrender. Empirically, this is not ideal for the solver- if the sync condition isn't met within several nanoseconds, it will tend to be some microseconds away. This spinwait is much more aggressive about moving to yields.
2) After a number of yields, the framework SpinWait will resort to calling Sleep. This widens the potential set of schedulable threads to those not native to the current core. If we permit that transition, it is likely to evict cached solver data. (For very large simulations, the use of Sleep(0) isn't that concerning- every iteration can be large enough to evict all of cache- but there still isn't much benefit to using it over yields in context.)
SpinWait will also fall back to Sleep(1) by default which obliterates performance, but that behavior can be disabled.
Note that this isn't an indication that the framework SpinWait should be changed, but rather that the solver's requirements are extremely specific and don't match a general purpose solution very well.)

member.name: P:BepuPhysics.Solver.FallbackBatchThreshold
member.summary: 获取在回退到回退求解器之前允许的最大求解器批次数量。如果单个物体受超过 FallbackBatchThreshold 个约束约束，超出 FallbackBatchThreshold 的所有约束都将放入回退批次中。回退批次使用不同的求解器，可以在单个批次中处理影响单个物体的多个约束，从而以收敛速度为代价实现更高的并行性。(Gets the maximum number of solver batches to allow before resorting to a fallback solver. If a single body is constrained by more than FallbackBatchThreshold constraints, all constraints beyond FallbackBatchThreshold are placed into a fallback batch. The fallback batch uses a different solver that can handle multiple constraints affecting a single body in a single batch, allowing greater parallelism at the cost of convergence speed.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.LocalSpinWait
member.summary: 行为类似于框架 SpinWait，但永远不会主动将时间片让给非核心线程。(Behaves like a framework SpinWait, but never voluntarily relinquishes the timeslice to off-core threads.)
member.remarks:
使用此方法而不是常规框架 SpinWait 有两个主要原因：
1) 框架 spinwait 在采取任何形式的放弃时间片之前会依赖相当长时间的旋转。经验表明，这对求解器来说并不理想——如果同步条件在几纳秒内不满足，它往往会在几微秒内满足。这个 spinwait 在产生方面更加积极。
2) 经过一定次数的产生后，框架 SpinWait 会转而调用 Sleep。这会将可调度线程的潜在集合扩大到那些不属于当前核心原生线程的线程。如果我们允许这种转换，很可能会驱逐缓存的求解器数据。（对于非常大的模拟，使用 Sleep(0) 并不是那么令人担忧——每次迭代都可能大到足以驱逐所有缓存——但在上下文中使用它相比产生仍然没有太多好处。）
SpinWait 还会默认回退到 Sleep(1)，这会严重破坏性能，但可以通过配置禁用该行为。
注意，这并不表示框架 SpinWait 应该更改，而是求解器的要求极其特殊，与通用解决方案不太匹配。 (
There are two big reasons for using this over the regular framework SpinWait:
1) The framework spinwait relies on spins for quite a while before resorting to any form of timeslice surrender. Empirically, this is not ideal for the solver- if the sync condition isn't met within several nanoseconds, it will tend to be some microseconds away. This spinwait is much more aggressive about moving to yields.
2) After a number of yields, the framework SpinWait will resort to calling Sleep. This widens the potential set of schedulable threads to those not native to the current core. If we permit that transition, it is likely to evict cached solver data. (For very large simulations, the use of Sleep(0) isn't that concerning- every iteration can be large enough to evict all of cache- but there still isn't much benefit to using it over yields in context.)
SpinWait will also fall back to Sleep(1) by default which obliterates performance, but that behavior can be disabled.
Note that this isn't an indication that the framework SpinWait should be changed, but rather that the solver's requirements are extremely specific and don't match a general purpose solution very well.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.AngularIntegrationMode.Nonconserving
member.summary: 角速度被直接积分，且不随物体位置变化而改变。不守恒角动量。(Angular velocity is directly integrated and does not change as the body pose changes. Does not conserve angular momentum.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.AngularIntegrationMode.ConserveMomentum
member.summary: 通过根据方向变化更新角速度来近似守恒角动量。对陀螺仪效果不错，但角速度往往会向最小惯性轴漂移。(Approximately conserves angular momentum by updating the angular velocity according to the change in orientation. Does a decent job for gyroscopes, but angular velocities will tend to drift towards a minimal inertia axis.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.AngularIntegrationMode.ConserveMomentumWithGyroscopicTorque
member.summary: 通过包含隐式陀螺力矩来近似守恒角动量。模拟 Dzhanibekov 效应的最佳选项，但会产生阻尼效果，可能使陀螺仪不太有用。(Approximately conserves angular momentum by including an implicit gyroscopic torque. Best option for Dzhanibekov effect simulation, but applies a damping effect that can make gyroscopes less useful.)

member.name: M:BepuPhysics.IPoseIntegratorCallbacks.PrepareForIntegration(System.Single)
member.summary: 在可能调用 的分发之前调用的回调。它可能在帧内以不同值被调用多次。例如，在执行边界框预测时，速度以全帧时间步长积分。在子步求解期间，积分被分割为 substepCount 个步长，每个步长持续 fullFrameDuration / substepCount。对于无约束物体的最终积分过程可能是 fullFrameDuration 或 fullFrameDuration / substepCount，具体取决于 AllowSubstepsForUnconstrainedBodies 的值。(Callback invoked ahead of dispatches that may call into . It may be called more than once with different values over a frame. For example, when performing bounding box prediction, velocity is integrated with a full frame time step duration. During substepped solves, integration is split into substepCount steps, each with fullFrameDuration / substepCount duration. The final integration pass for unconstrained bodies may be either fullFrameDuration or fullFrameDuration / substepCount, depending on the value of AllowSubstepsForUnconstrainedBodies.)
member.param: 当前积分时间步长持续时间。(Current integration time step duration.)
member.remarks: 这通常用于预计算将在速度积分中使用的任何昂贵内容。(This is typically used for precomputing anything expensive that will be used across velocity integration.)

member.summary: 增加任何对于容纳分配目标来说过小的缓冲区的分配大小，并减小任何不必要过大的缓冲区的分配大小。(Increases the allocation size of any buffers too small to hold the allocation target, and decreases the allocation size of any buffers that are unnecessarily large.)
member.remarks:
缓冲区的最终大小受分配器约束。不能保证精确等于目标，但保证至少与目标一样大。
这主要是一个便利函数。它内部所做的一切都可以在外部完成。例如，如果只需要调整类型批次的大小，可以直接使用求解器自己的函数。
(The final size of the allocated buffers are constrained by the allocator. It is not guaranteed to be exactly equal to the target, but it is guaranteed to be at least as large. This is primarily a convenience function. Everything it does internally can be done externally. For example, if only type batches need to be resized, the solver's own functions can be used directly.)
member.param: 要保证足够大小的分配大小。(Allocation sizes to guarantee sufficient size for.)

member.name: P:BepuPhysics.Solver.FallbackBatchThreshold
member.summary: 获取在回退到回退求解器之前允许的最大求解器批次数。如果单个物体受到超过 FallbackBatchThreshold 个约束的约束，则超出 FallbackBatchThreshold 的所有约束将被放入回退批次中。回退批次使用不同的求解器，该求解器可以在单个批次中处理影响单个物体的多个约束，从而提高并行性但牺牲收敛速度。(Gets the maximum number of solver batches to allow before resorting to a fallback solver. If a single body is constrained by more than FallbackBatchThreshold constraints, all constraints beyond FallbackBatchThreshold are placed into a fallback batch. The fallback batch uses a different solver that can handle multiple constraints affecting a single body in a single batch, allowing greater parallelism at the cost of convergence speed.)

member.name: M:BepuPhysics.StaticReference.UpdateBounds
member.summary: 根据静态物体的当前状态更新宽阶段中的边界。不包括速度扩展。如果静态物体没有形状，则不执行任何操作。(Updates the static's bounds in the broad phase for its current state. Does not include velocity expansion. Does nothing if the static has no shape.)
member.remarks: 如果在下一个时间步之前希望将修改的静态状态反映在宽阶段中，此方法会很有用。例如，如果直接移动物体后要对其执行射线投射，则必须更新其边界，否则宽阶段边界将过时，射线很可能会错过。(Can be useful if you made modifications to the static's state that you want reflected in the broad phase before the next timestep. For example, if you want to perform ray casts against the broad phase after moving objects around directly, their bounds must be updated or else the broad phase bounds will be out of date and the ray will likely miss.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.IStaticChangeAwakeningFilter
member.summary: 定义确定当静态物体状态改变时其边界框内哪些物体应被唤醒的类型。(Defines a type that determines which bodies should be awoken in the bounding box of a static when the static's state changes.)
member.remarks: 我们无法通过约束找到依赖静态的物体，因为静态不维护约束列表。当添加、移除静态、调用 SetShape 或 ApplyDescription 时，它会查找其边界框中可能受更改影响的物体，并考虑唤醒它们。此过滤器可用于忽略某些物体。(We cannot find bodies depending on a static through constraints, since statics do not maintain constraint lists. When a static is added, removed, has SetShape or has ApplyDescription called on it, it looks up bodies in its bounding box that could possibly be affected by change and considers waking them up. This filter can be used to ignore some bodies.)

member.name: P:BepuPhysics.IStaticChangeAwakeningFilter.AllowAwakening
member.summary: 获取是否允许唤醒任何物体。如果为 true，候选物将调用 ShouldAwaken 函数。如果为 false，将不调用 ShouldAwaken，且没有物体会被唤醒。(Gets whether to allow awakening for any body. If true, candidates will have the ShouldAwaken function called for them. If false, ShouldAwaken will not be called, and no bodies will be awoken.)

member.name: M:BepuPhysics.IStaticChangeAwakeningFilter.ShouldAwaken(BepuPhysics.BodyReference)
member.summary: 确定物体是否应由静态物体的状态变化强制唤醒。(Determines whether a body should be forced awake by the state change of a static.)
member.param: 考虑唤醒的休眠物体。(Sleeping body under consideration for awakening.)
member.returns: 如果物体应被强制唤醒，则返回 true；否则返回 false。(True if the body should be forced awake, false otherwise.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.StaticsShouldntAwakenKinematics
member.summary: 仅唤醒动力学物体的默认唤醒过滤器。运动学物体不响应任何类型的动态模拟，因此它们不会响应静态物体的变化。(Default awakening filter that only wakes up dynamic bodies. Kinematic bodies do not respond to any kind of dynamic simulation, so they won't respond to the change in statics.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.StaticsShouldntAwakenBodies
member.summary: 阻止任何物体因静态物体状态变化而被唤醒的唤醒过滤器。(Awakening filter that prevents any bodies from being awoken by the static's state change.)

member.name: T:BepuPhysics.Static
member.summary: 存储模拟中静态碰撞体的数据。静态物体可以被放置并碰撞，但没有速度且没有动态行为。(Stores data for a static collidable in the simulation. Statics can be posed and collide, but have no velocity and no dynamic behavior.)
member.remarks: 与物体不同，静态物体的访问模式非常简单。大多数数据一起被引用，并且没有像求解器中那样的极端高频数据访问。所有内容可以方便地连续存储在一个位置。(Unlike bodies, statics have a very simple access pattern. Most data is referenced together and there are no extreme high frequency data accesses like there are in the solver. Everything can be conveniently stored within a single location contiguously.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.Static.Pose
member.summary: 静态碰撞体的位置。(Pose of the static collidable.)

member.name: F:BepuPhysics.Static.Continuity
member.summary: 此碰撞体的连续碰撞检测设置。包括要使用的碰撞检测模式以及与这些模式关联的调整变量。注意，静态物体不能移动，因此 和 之间没有区别。启用 仍将要求与静态关联的对使用扫描连续碰撞检测。(Continuous collision detection settings for this collidable. Includes the collision detection mode to use and tuning variables associated with those modes. Note that statics cannot move, so there is no difference between and for them. member.name: M:BepuPhysics.Statics.AddWithoutAwakeningBodies(BepuPhysics.StaticDescription@)
member.summary: 向模拟中添加一个新的静态物体。不尝试唤醒静态物体附近的休眠物体。(Adds a new static body to the simulation. No attempt is made to awaken sleeping bodies near the static.)
member.param: 要添加的静态物体的描述。(Description of the static to add.)
member.returns: 新静态物体的句柄。(Handle of the new static.)
member.remarks:
对于大多数用例，推荐使用默认的 函数；它可以通过唤醒新静态附近的休眠物体来帮助避免意外行为。然而，查询确实会带来非零成本。
如果一次添加许多静态物体，特别是新静态与大量现有静态重叠，并且不需要唤醒休眠物体，则可以使用此函数来避免查询成本。
其他自定义过滤器可用于控制哪些物体被唤醒；请参阅 和 接口。 (For most use cases, defaulting to the function is recommended; it can help avoid surprising behavior by waking up sleeping bodies near the new static. The query does, however, carry a nonzero cost.
If many statics are being added at once, particularly if the new statics overlap with a lot of existing statics, and there's no need to awaken sleeping bodies, this function can be used to avoid the cost of the query.
Other custom filters can be used to control which bodies are awoken; see and the interface.)

member.remarks: 这执行无增量细化。当在同一棵树上操作时，它比 略便宜，但树的质量取决于插入顺序。病态的插入顺序可能导致最大不平衡的树，整个树构建的二次插入时间，以及随叶子数量线性增长的查询性能。这通常最适合插入顺序已知为随机或其他有利于构建良好树的情况。(This performs no incremental refinement. When acting on the same tree, it's slightly cheaper than , but the quality of the tree depends on insertion order. Pathological insertion orders can result in a maximally imbalanced tree, quadratic insertion times across the full tree build, and query performance linear in the number of leaves. This is typically best reserved for cases where the insertion order is known to be randomized or otherwise conducive to building decent trees.)
